sources.label: Showplace Square / Northeast Mission Historic Resource Survey, adopted 2011

historical_record.description: Built as an industrial building, recorded as occupied by Oregon Worsted Co.

building.completed_conflict: The assessor dates the building to 2023; the city's 2011 survey of Showplace Square and the northeast Mission dates it to 1880.

unknowns: The survey's data table dates the building to 1880; the context statement's appendix dates it to 1907. The survey's data table dates the building to 1880; its own note describes it as the lower floor of a two-storey building that stood before 1889.

historic_survey.survey: Showplace Square / Northeast Mission Historic Resource Survey (2011)
historic_survey.eligible_district: Northeast Mission / Showplace Square Industrial Employment District (proposed)
historic_survey.physical_integrity: 5 of 7 aspects retained, on the survey's scale
historic_survey.note: The survey rates the architecture 2 of 5. The 2009 context statement gives the status code 3CD; the 2011 survey data table gives 3CS. California Register criteria cited: 1.
historic_survey.status_code_meaning: California Historical Resource Status Codes: a 1 or 2 means listed or formally determined eligible, a 3 means the survey judged it eligible, a 5 means locally significant, a 6 that it was found ineligible, and a 7 that it was not evaluated.
